findings.text: 在 DSH 中查询 TS、TSX、JS、JSX 文件的定义、引用、实现、hover。
ts provider 默认启动 typescript-language-server --stdio，四扩展映射至相应 language id，复用 LspStdio。
静态审阅固定提交的 dsh-lsp-ts 子组件；未运行语言服务器或插件。
包 MIT；typescript-language-server 与 TypeScript 另有许可，部署前另核。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次使用 | 外部typescript-language-server/建议typescript与共享基座下载/磁盘，价格未知 | 核PATH、DSH执行世界、四language id和项目配置，工时未知 | 包不装server，单sample.ts无tsconfig不等所有项目适配 |
| 持续使用 | 共享stdio按需起server，tsserver工作区索引/文档/内存，量未知 | 核TS/TSX/JS/JSX导航及tsconfig边界，工时未知 | 延迟启动/进程预算是基座职责；不推项目资源零成本 |
| 失败恢复 | server重启/重索引或依赖重装资源，金额未知 | 区分缺命令、配置/注册故障，恢复自定义扩展路由，工时未知 | fallback保默认四扩展但丢自定义，真实恢复率未知 |
先核主机 server、共享基座，再在真实 TS/TSX/JS/JSX 项目试四操作；详见[Q03](#research-q03)。
减少手工配置四种扩展；导航质量取决于外部服务器。
配置覆盖合并；LspStdio 延迟启动；缺服异常由 fallback 返回 LSP_UNAVAILABLE。
减少 TS/JS LSP 命令和语言 id 装配；协议由共享基座实现，详见[Q01](#research-q01)。
宽 catch 可能误判配置故障，fallback 丢失自定义扩展；详见[Q02](#research-q02)。
故障分类并让fallback保留合并映射，可证伪对照及代价见[Q05](#research-q05)。

technical.rationale: novelty以手配相同TypeScript language server与共享LSP为参照，无新语言算法0（Q01）；mechanism以直接配置为参照，命令/四映射合并及fallback提供有限装配8，协议/索引归基座和server（Q01/Q02）；transferability以单机固定路径为参照，命令参数/env/预算覆盖支持安装差异10，仍绑定DSH接口（Q03）；simplification以手填四language id为参照，默认值减少配置8，但server安装和tsconfig排错仍在（Q04）。

business.rationale: workflow以手工给共享基座配命令/四扩展为参照，现成包减少配置交接18（Q01）；delivery以同一server的定义/引用/实现/hover为参照，未改变交付产物/验收单位0，安装封装不算新交付（Q01）；reach以需理解四扩展language id的DSH用户为参照，默认映射降低接入门槛5，不能因TS/JS受众广泛直接加触达分（Q01/Q03）；economics以手配同一基座/server为参照，本包未新增缓存/索引或共享资源组织0，延迟启动归基座，省配置计workflow且净收益未知（Q04）。

recommendation.reason: 已有 DSH LSP 基座及 TypeScript language server 的 TS/JS 团队可隔离试用。

advantage.rationale: 四扩展默认映射和降级。

evidence.rationale: 源码与测试可查，真实项目未测。

cost.rationale: 需另装服务器及共享基座。

# dsh-lsp-ts > 以外部 TypeScript language server 为 TS/JS 文件提供四扩展路由的 DSH LSP 配置包。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs) - **版本号**：0.1.0（[固定提交 258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/tree/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce)） - **版本日期**：2026-09-01（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 源码支持路由和缺服 fallback；真实服务及四扩展项目导航未验证。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：在 DSH 中查询 TS、TSX、JS、JSX 文件的定义、引用、实现、hover。 - **亮点**：减少 TS/JS LSP 命令和语言 id 装配；协议由共享基座实现，详见[Q01](#research-q01)。 - **思考**：宽 catch 可能误判配置故障，fallback 丢失自定义扩展；详见[Q02](#research-q02)。 - **建议**：故障分类并让fallback保留合并映射，可证伪对照及代价见[Q05](#research-q05)。 采用建议：先核主机 server、共享基座，再在真实 TS/TSX/JS/JSX 项目试四操作；详见[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 核心贡献 减少 TS/JS LSP 命令和语言 id 装配；协议由共享基座实现，详见[Q01](#research-q01)。 ## 关键质疑 宽 catch 可能误判配置故障，fallback 丢失自定义扩展；详见[Q02](#research-q02)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 故障分类并让fallback保留合并映射，可证伪对照及代价见[Q05](#research-q05)。 测缺服/非法配置/自定义扩展，以及真实多文件 TS/JS 四操作。 ## 场景与替代办法 在 DSH 中查询 TS、TSX、JS、JSX 文件的定义、引用、实现、hover。 手工在共享 LSP 配置注册 typescript-language-server 和四扩展映射。 ## 依赖与流程 DSH LSP service/tool、fs/subprocess、typescript-language-server 和建议的 TypeScript。 安装服务器与 TypeScript→挂共享基座→安装包→测试四扩展导航。 ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次使用 | 外部typescript-language-server/建议typescript与共享基座下载/磁盘，价格未知 | 核PATH、DSH执行世界、四language id和项目配置，工时未知 | 包不装server，单sample.ts无tsconfig不等所有项目适配 | | 持续使用 | 共享stdio按需起server，tsserver工作区索引/文档/内存，量未知 | 核TS/TSX/JS/JSX导航及tsconfig边界，工时未知 | 延迟启动/进程预算是基座职责；不推项目资源零成本 | | 失败恢复 | server重启/重索引或依赖重装资源，金额未知 | 区分缺命令、配置/注册故障，恢复自定义扩展路由，工时未知 | fallback保默认四扩展但丢自定义，真实恢复率未知 | 减少手工配置四种扩展；导航质量取决于外部服务器。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标：**核实 TypeScript/JavaScript LSP 薄包的四扩展映射、外部服务器要求及缺服降级。 ### Q01 · TypeScript/JavaScript 导航由语言包还是共享基座提供？ **研究主题：**场景与需求、贡献与相对优势、功能与机制 #### 完整回答 包仅把 .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx 映射至四个 LSP language id，并以 typescript-language-server --stdio 注册 ts provider；协议、进程托管与模型侧 lsp 工具依赖共享基座。README 指引另行安装 typescript-language-server 和 typescript，包不下载服务器。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-ts/src/index.ts:21-49](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-ts/src/index.ts#L21-L49) 注入依赖、provider、命令、参数和四扩展映射。
查看原文（29行） ```text import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis' import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery' import { LspError, LspProviderId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp' import type { LspProvider, LspProviderQuery, LspQueryResult } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp' import * as LspStdio from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio' import type { LspLocalServerConfig } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio' /** Cordis plugin name for loader diagnostics. */ export const name = 'lsp-ts' /** Services required by the shared LSP base this pack assembles. */ export const inject = ['fs', 'lsp', 'subprocess'] /** Stable provider id reserved on `ctx.lsp` by this pack. */ export const PROVIDER_ID = 'ts' /** Default server command (absolute path or PATH-resolved executable, no shell). */ export const DEFAULT_COMMAND = 'typescript-language-server' /** Default launch arguments. */ export const DEFAULT_ARGS: readonly string[] = ["--stdio"] /** Default lowercase leading-dot extension → LSP language id table. */ export const DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE: Readonly> = { ".ts": "typescript", ".tsx": "typescriptreact", ".js": "javascript", ".jsx": "javascriptreact" } ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-ts/src/index.ts:155-163](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-ts/src/index.ts#L155-L163) 把解析后的服务器配置交给共享 LspStdio。 ```text export async function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): Promise { const server = resolveServerConfig(config) try { // Resolve through lsp-stdio’s own Config schema so every documented default // (timer budgets, byte caps, env, ...) is filled before apply() — calling the // stdio apply directly bypasses the Cordis loader’s schema pass. const stdioConfig = LspStdio.Config({ servers: { [PROVIDER_ID]: server } }) await LspStdio.apply(ctx, stdioConfig) return ``` **依据 3 · 作者声明**：[dsh-lsp-ts/README.md:6-25](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-ts/README.md#L6-L25) 声明薄包和外部服务器安装前提。
查看原文（20行） ````text This pack is one Cordis configuration plugin: it registers a configured `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio` instance on `ctx.lsp` with the server command, launch arguments, and extension mapping for TypeScript / JavaScript. It implements **no LSP protocol** — the shared base does: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp` (the seam) + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-lsp` (the model-facing `lsp` tool with `goToDefinition` / `findReferences` / `goToImplementation` / `hover`). Twelve packs reuse one unchanged base. ## Installing the language server ```bash npm install -g typescript-language-server typescript # or: yarn global add typescript-language-server typescript # or: pnpm add -g typescript-language-server typescript ``` The server embeds its own `tsserver`; installing `typescript` next to it is still recommended. > ⚠️ The plugin itself **never downloads or installs the server binary** — matching the > upstream anthropics LSP plugins, the server is an external prerequisite. The plugin only > resolves and launches it. ````
#### 缺口 - 未启动真实 TypeScript language server **影响：**跨文件定义、引用与项目配置下表现未知 **进一步探讨：**在真实 TS/JS 项目试四操作和跨文件导航 ### Q02 · 缺服 fallback 是否覆盖自定义映射并能区分故障？ **研究主题：**工程质量与复用、缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 正常配置合并自定义 extensionToLanguage；但 Config 和 apply 的全部异常被同一个 catch 归因为默认命令不可用，fallback 只用默认四扩展注册。若自定义 .xyz，降级时该路由丢失。resolveServerConfig 在 try 之前，也并非所有加载错误都可降级。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-ts/src/index.ts:105-120](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-ts/src/index.ts#L105-L120) 用户扩展覆盖合并与配置生成。
查看原文（16行） ```text /** Merge the pack defaults with the user overrides into one stdio server entry. */ export function resolveServerConfig(config: Config): ResolvedServerConfig { const server: ResolvedServerConfig = { command: config.command ?? DEFAULT_COMMAND, args: config.args ?? [...DEFAULT_ARGS], extensionToLanguage: { ...DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE, ...(config.extensionToLanguage ?? {}) }, } if (config.env !== undefined) server.env = config.env if (config.initializationOptions !== undefined) server.initializationOptions = config.initializationOptions if (config.configuration !== undefined) server.configuration = config.configuration if (config.maxMessageBytes !== undefined) server.maxMessageBytes = config.maxMessageBytes if (config.maxStderrBytes !== undefined) server.maxStderrBytes = config.maxStderrBytes if (config.maxDocumentBytes !== undefined) server.maxDocumentBytes = config.maxDocumentBytes if (config.shutdownTimeoutMs !== undefined) server.shutdownTimeoutMs = config.shutdownTimeoutMs if (config.killGraceMs !== undefined) server.killGraceMs = config.killGraceMs return server ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-ts/src/index.ts:123-173](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-ts/src/index.ts#L123-L173) LSP_UNAVAILABLE fallback、宽 catch 与默认映射。
查看原文（51行） ```text /** A provider that keeps extension routing alive while the server is missing. */ class UnavailableProvider implements LspProvider { readonly id = LspProviderId(PROVIDER_ID) readonly extensionToLanguage: Readonly> constructor(extensions: Readonly>, private readonly reason: string) { this.extensionToLanguage = { ...extensions } } query(_request: LspProviderQuery): Promise { const message = 'language server for ' + PROVIDER_ID + ' is unavailable: ' + this.reason + '. ' + 'Install the language server (see the pack README) and reload the profile or session.' return Promise.reject(new LspError(message, 'LSP_UNAVAILABLE')) } } /** Extract a stable message from an unknown load-time failure. */ function failureMessage(error: unknown): string { if (error instanceof Error) return error.message return String(error) } /** * Register the configured stdio provider for the language, or a structured * no-server fallback when the executable cannot be resolved at load. * * The pack never crashes the session: an unresolvable server only disables * this language routing and surfaces `LSP_UNAVAILABLE` on queries. * @param ctx - the plugin context (must inject `fs`, `lsp`, `subprocess`). * @param config - the resolved pack configuration. */ export async function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): Promise { const server = resolveServerConfig(config) try { // Resolve through lsp-stdio’s own Config schema so every documented default // (timer budgets, byte caps, env, ...) is filled before apply() — calling the // stdio apply directly bypasses the Cordis loader’s schema pass. const stdioConfig = LspStdio.Config({ servers: { [PROVIDER_ID]: server } }) await LspStdio.apply(ctx, stdioConfig) return } catch (error) { const reason = failureMessage(error) console.warn('[' + name + '] ' + DEFAULT_COMMAND + ' unavailable at load: ' + reason) ctx.effect(() => { const dispose = ctx.lsp.registerProvider( new UnavailableProvider(DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE, reason), ) return () => dispose() }, name + '.unavailableFallback') } ```
**依据 3 · 作者声明**：[dsh-lsp-ts/README.md:34-58](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-ts/README.md#L34-L58) 声明 lazy start、缺服降级和自定义覆盖。
查看原文（25行） ````text ## How the pack works - **Lazy start**: the server process is **not** started at load. `lsp-stdio` launches it lazily on the first matching query and keeps one process per workspace. - **No-server fallback**: if the executable cannot be resolved, the pack still loads; every `lsp` query for these extensions fails with a structured `LSP_UNAVAILABLE` error naming the command — the rest of the session is unaffected. - **Config overrides**: every default below can be overridden from the composition row, e.g. a server installed at a non-standard path: ```yaml - id: lsp-ts name: '@dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-ts' config: command: /absolute/path/to/typescript-language-server args: - --stdio extensionToLanguage: '.xyz': custom-language-id maxDocumentBytes: 8000000 ``` All fields of the `servers` table documented in the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio` README are accepted (`command`, `args`, `env`, `extensionToLanguage`, `initializationOptions`, `configuration`, byte/time bounds). ````
#### 缺口 - 未模拟配置/注册错误和自定义扩展缺服 **影响：**用户可见错误与路由范围需实测 **进一步探讨：**隔离分别测试缺 binary、配置异常和自定义扩展 ### Q03 · 采用前提和已有测试证据到哪里？ **研究主题：**依赖、兼容与流程、采用判断 #### 完整回答 需 DSH LSP service/tool 与同执行世界的 fs/subprocess，主机需有 typescript-language-server（推荐另装 typescript）。源码包含默认值、缺服两条离线测试及有 server 才运行的四操作单文件 sample.ts 测试；存在测试代码不代表本研究运行通过，也未覆盖 TS/JS 多文件项目或四扩展各自行为。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[dsh-lsp-ts/README.md:13-25](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-ts/README.md#L13-L25) 外部安装及 TypeScript 依赖说明。

The plugin only > resolves and launches it. ````
**依据 2 · 作者声明**：[dsh-lsp-ts/README.md:60-92](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-ts/README.md#L60-L92) 共享基座挂载、测试 lane 和单文件范围。
查看原文（33行） ````text ## Mounting 1. Mount the shared base **once** (the `lsp` service, the `lsp` tool, and a filesystem/subprocess pair for the same execution world) — ready-made snippet in `examples/base-composition.cordis.yml` of the dsh-lsp-packs repo. 2. Install the pack (its `cordis.yml` is the `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the row inserts itself): ```bash dsh plugin add @dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-ts # published name dsh plugin add /path/to/dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-ts # or a local checkout ``` or compose the row directly (name resolved from the installed package): ```yaml - insert: - id: lsp-ts name: '@dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-ts' ``` ## Smoke test ```bash pnpm vitest run --dir dsh-lsp-ts # or from the repo root: pnpm test ``` - Lane 1 (offline): asserts the defaults (command / args / extension table / provider id). - Lane 2 (offline): asserts the missing-server fallback returns `LSP_UNAVAILABLE`. - Lane 3 (needs the server): runs the four `lsp` operations against `sample.ts`; it **auto-skips** when `typescript-language-server` is not on PATH. No `tsconfig.json` is required for single-file queries; this mirrors the pinned upstream TS e2e. ````
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-ts/tests/smoke.e2e.ts:24-101](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-ts/tests/smoke.e2e.ts#L24-L101) binary 探测、离线默认和缺服测试、真实 lane 自动 skip。
查看原文（78行） ```text /** Probe whether the language server binary truly runs. */ function probeServer(command: string): boolean { const probe = spawnSync(command, ['--version'], { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 10_000, shell: process.platform === 'win32', }) // Spawn failure or timeout (ENOENT / killed) never counts as installed. if (probe.error !== undefined || probe.status === null) return false if (probe.status === 0) return true // Some servers (e.g. sourcekit-lsp) reject `--version` with a usage error while // running fine; only output saying the binary itself is missing skips the lane // (this also skips a rustup shim whose component is not installed). const output = String(probe.stdout ??
